_note: Voice casting for The Reckoner of the Thirteenth Hour (1st person, past tense: Petra Sandor). Petra's own lines stay on the narrator voice (gemini.voices c-petra-sandor = "narrator"). gemini.narrator overrides config/tts.json gemini.narrator. Main voices kept distinct from knot-mender, down-is-where-i-say and fifth-floor-tenant. lexicon: Kokoro IPA; respell: Gemini only. Cast 2026-11-13, not yet approved by Ben.

respell._note: Gemini only: words replaced in the text sent to Gemini. Roman plate numerals: narrate speakable() title-cases ALL-CAPS words (XII -> Xii, IV -> Iv), which Gemini would misread, so they are spelled out here (case-insensitive whole words). Single I (plate I) cannot be respelled safely.

narrator.style: Plain, exact, watchful British woman in her thirties, a night auditor who has not slept a whole night in years, telling her own story in the past tense; low and level, never jokey or ironic; fear stated flatly and left alone; numbers said carefully and exactly; natural pace with clear pauses between paragraphs

c-anselm-whitlow.style: Slow, exact, tired old British man, a retired Reckoner; kindly evasive, answers a question with a better question; a yawn held back under the words

c-marguerite-lisle.style: Fast, loud, slangy young British woman, a sprinter; always making bets; generous with praise and insults; goes very quiet when scared

c-bao-tran.style: Slow, warm, sleepy young British man of few words; half awake, gentle sleepy humour; says mm for yes

c-tamsin-drewe.style: Deadpan young British woman, a clockmaker's daughter; dry delivery of terrible puns; quick and offhand

c-cassius-orme.style: Polished, courteous British gentleman administrator; speaks in complete smooth paragraphs; compliments that are really weapons; never raises his voice

c-severine-holt.style: Brisk British bank governor, numbers first; smooth banker's euphemisms; never threatens, only states consequences

c-dunstan-mabry.style: Genial, avuncular British fixer; everything is a little arrangement; warm, chummy and unhurried
